name: Put Front Ratio Spread (1x2)
summary: Buy 1 nearer put and sell 2 further OTM puts for a credit; profits from a drift down to the short strike, with large risk below it.

legs.strike_rule: ATM or slightly ITM, put delta -0.50 to -0.60
OTM strike at put delta -0.25 to -0.30, chosen so the package opens at a net credit

when_to_use: COMPLETENESS / LEVEL 4 unless both short puts are fully cash-secured. With put skew, the credit is usually easy to obtain. Under Level 3 the correct substitute is the broken-wing put butterfly, which caps the downside tail.
max_profit: (long strike - short strike) x 100 + net credit, at the short strike
max_loss: (short strike x 100) - max profit, on a move to zero - effectively undefined for risk-management purposes
breakevens: upside: none when opened for a credit; downside breakeven = short strike - (long strike - short strike) - credit/100

greeks.delta: negative at entry, turns positive below the short strike

entry_rules: AT LEVEL 3: permitted ONLY if both short puts are fully cash-secured - reserve 2 x (short strike x 100) - credit in cash. On a $50k account this restricts it to underlyings under $50. Otherwise the router must reject it as a level 4 structure.
Open for a net credit only.
Short strike delta between -0.25 and -0.30; long strike delta -0.50 to -0.60.
IV rank >= 50; no earnings inside the expiry.
Both strikes: OI >= 500, per-leg spread <= max($0.05, 10% of mid).
Level-3 substitute (preferred): add a long put below the shorts, converting to a broken-wing put butterfly.
management_rules: Close at 21 DTE regardless of P/L.
Close if spot trades below the short strike at any time.
Stop: close if the short put delta reaches -0.45.
exit_rules: ASSIGNMENT GUARD: 2 short puts, 1 uncovered by the long; flatten by 15:45 ET on expiration day, unconditionally.
ASSIGNMENT GUARD: close immediately if the short puts are ITM with extrinsic < $0.10.
Close any ITM short put by 2 DTE unconditionally.
assignment_risk: Assignment on both shorts buys 200 shares per unit; only 100 of those are hedged by the long put. The unhedged 100 shares are an outright long position taken at a price above market. On a $50k account this must never happen.
buying_power: Cash-secured requirement on 2 short puts (2 x strike x 100 - credit) at Level 3, or naked put margin at Level 4.
common_mistakes: Opening for a debit; underestimating that a 1x2 put ratio on an index ETF is a short-crash position; using it instead of the capped BWB version for no additional edge.
zero_dte_notes: Not recommended - an unhedged short put at 0DTE means same-day share delivery risk.
family: three-leg-structures (butterflies, broken-wing butterflies, lizards, three-strike ratio spreads, ladders/tree spreads, christmas trees, and three-leg stock+option hybrids)
blocked_because: needs Alpaca options level 4; this account is level 3. Alpaca rejects it with 'account not eligible to trade uncovered option contracts'. Raising the level is an Alpaca approval, not a code change.
